problem_statement: This is the Cleaning Company marketing website (a static multi-page Bootstrap site): a Home landing page plus About, Services, Pricing, Portfolio, Blog and Contact pages sharing one navbar and footer. The Services page presents the company's six cleaning services (Office, Pool, Carpet, Kitchen, Garden and Window Cleaning) as a card grid. The marketing team wants a small, consistent 'Browse our services' finder to sit at the top of the services area: a titled panel that lists those services as cards, with a row of category tabs (All / Interior / Exterior / Deep clean) and a live 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' readout, so a prospect can filter the services to the area they need. Ship the finder so it (1) appears on the Services page AND is echoed on the Home and About pages so the offer is discoverable across the marketing site, (2) lays out its tab row responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) matches the site's own visual language (blue-accent active tab, rounded hairline-bordered cards, legible high-contrast card names) rather than an off-brand or unreadable slab, and (4) keeps the category filter live so clicking a tab re-filters the cards and updates the readout count. Keep the rest of the site — the shared navbar and footer, the pricing tables, the contact form and the existing page content — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Browse our services' finder at the top of the services area so it renders on the Services page and is echoed on the Home and About pages (one shared block, not divergent per-page copies).

The finder shows a 'Browse our services' title, a category tab row (All, Interior, Exterior, Deep clean), a live 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' readout, and a grid of cards for the company's six services.
The tab row must wrap responsively so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Style the finder in the site's own visual language (blue-accent active tab, rounded hairline-bordered cards, high-contrast legible card names), not an off-brand grey slab or an unreadable low-contrast panel with overlapping cards.

Wire the category filter to the tabs: after clicking the Interior tab, the readout must read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Interior' and only the interior cards remain visible - it must recompute the filter live, not show a stale captured count.
Preserve the shared navbar and footer, the pricing tables, the contact form and the existing page content with no console or network errors.
design_constraints: Implement the finder as a shared block so a single source of truth reaches the Services, Home and About pages; do not paste divergent copies per page or gate it to a subset of pages.

The tab row must use a fluid, wrapping layout (flex-wrap, no fixed-width nowrap track) and the card grid must collapse from three columns to one on a narrow phone, so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The finder must adopt the site's visual idiom: the active category tab filled with the blue primary accent, the panel and cards drawn with rounded corners and hairline borders on the light surface, and card names in dark high-contrast text so every label is legible (no near-white text on a pale fill).

The panel title, the tab row, the readout line and the card grid must be laid out with clear vertical spacing so no element overlaps or collides with another (no negative margins that shingle the cards or push the title into the tabs).

The category filter must recompute the visible cards and the 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' readout from the live DOM after every tab click, so the count and the shown cards can never go stale relative to the active tab.
Do not remove or regress the shared navbar and footer, the pricing tables, the contact form, or the existing page content.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Home landing page and responsive shell.
desktop_services and mobile_services scroll the Services finder into view and must show the on-brand finder without horizontal overflow.
desktop_index and desktop_about protect the finder's echoed presence at the top of the Home and About page content.
desktop_services_interior_filter clicks the Interior category tab; the readout must then read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Interior'.

change_completion: The Services finder is present at the top of the services area on the Services page and is echoed on the Home and About pages (the shared block reaches every marketing surface).
After clicking the Interior category tab, the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Interior' - the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 6 of 6 · All'.
design_consistency: The finder on the lever states matches the reference's on-brand styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-brand or unreadable slab.
The finder adopts the blue-accent/hairline idiom and keeps card names high-contrast and legible.
responsive: No captured page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the tab row wraps.
desktop_services and mobile_services keep the finder readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The shared navbar and footer, the pricing tables and the contact form remain present and functional.
The existing page content is not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

author_notes: slot_224 DEDUP + L4 hardening on the technext/cleaning-company static Bootstrap marketing site, reassigned off the shared StartBootstrap Modern Business repo (which slot_131 keeps). The full site content is shared byte-identically across legs; the L4 levers ride on a new shared 'Browse our services' finder placed at the top of the services area and echoed on the Home and About marketing pages. reference = finder on all three pages, fluid wrap tab row, on-brand blue-accent/hairline card styling, live category filter + count readout (passes D2/D3/D4/D6). The finder renders as a rounded blue-accent card with an accent-highlighted active tab and a legible 3-column grid of service cards. baseline = the original unrepaired finder: present on the Services page only (fails D2 cross-page on Home/About), fixed 760px nowrap tab track (fails D6 mobile overflow ~410px), flat off-brand grey slab (fails D3), but its category filter IS live (passes D4). bad = a 'smart wrong' finder: present on Services+Home only (fails D2 About), 560px nowrap + overflow-x:hidden shallow non-fix (fails D6 ~210px), and a genuinely BROKEN panel - near-white card names on pale grey (unreadable), the title pulled up with a negative margin so it collides with the tab row, and cards shingled with negative margins so they overlap (fails D3) - plus the tab click flips the active tab but the readout and cards stay frozen at 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' (fails D4). bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. INFRA (identical 3 legs, measurement-enabling, not a fix): vendor the Google Fonts / FontAwesome / Google Maps remote resources to local (drop the maps script, use a local FontAwesome build) and neutralise the template's ftco scroll-animation so content is visible and un-shifted in static screenshots; the site is otherwise served as-is with no build step. Asset/visual grounding: the D3 visual-regression gate is anchored on the reference screenshots of desktop_services and mobile_services plus per-component image crops of the .svc finder and its .svc__card cards; the local images/*.jpg photography and the services page card grid are the asset-path signals; the graded service cards, category tabs and 'Showing N of 6' readout are all visible, machine-checkable render surfaces in those captured states.

metadata.design_goal: add a shared, interactive services finder across the Services, Home and About pages while keeping content, navigation and layout stable
